“Good morning, and thank you for this opportunity. My name is Ritika Kumari, and I am currently pursuing my B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering from BIT Sindri.
I am skilled in the MERN stack and have a good understanding of problem-solving, Data Structures and Algorithms, particularly in C++. Last summer, I completed my internship at Siemens Technology and Services, where I got the opportunity to work in Generative AI and RAG-based applications.
I have also worked on several web development projects, which gave me the opportunity to apply these skills to real-world problems.
Apart from academics, I am quite interested in participating in hackathons and technical competitions. In 2024, my team was selected for the Smart India Hackathon Grand Finale, and we also secured All India Rank 2 in the DRDO Dare to Dream Contest 5.0.

I would love to utilize my technical skills, gain practical industry experience, and contribute to the organization while continuing to learn and grow. Thank you.”

Good morning, and thank you for giving me this opportunity.
My name is Ritika Kumari, and I am currently pursuing my B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering from BIT Sindri, with a CGPA of 8.54.
I am primarily interested in software development and problem solving. I am skilled in the MERN stack, and I have a good understanding of Data Structures and Algorithms and problem solving in C++. 
During my degree, I have worked on several web development projects, which helped me gain hands-on experience with technologies like React, Node.js.

During my degree, I have worked on several web development projects, which helped me gain hands-on experience with technologies like React, Node.js. 
Last summer, I had the opportunity to intern at Siemens Technology and Services, where I got exposure to Generative AI and RAG-based applications. I worked on a RAG-based chatbot using technologies such as LangChain, FastAPI, Streamlit, and FAISS, which gave me the opportunity to understand how AI can be used to retrieve relevant information and provide context-aware responses. 
Apart from academics, I am quite interested in participating in hackathons and technical competitions. In 2024, my team was selected for the Smart India Hackathon Grand Finale, and we also secured All India Rank 2 in the DRDO Dare to Dream Contest 5.0. I was also fortunate to be recognized as a Siemens Scholar.

At this stage of my career, I am looking for an opportunity where I can apply my technical skills to real-world problems, gain practical industry knowledge, learn from experienced professionals, and contribute to the organization.
That’s a brief introduction about me. Thank you.”
